# clo_project (Resource)

Manage a CLO project, its metadata and its power state. Import using the project ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `description` (String) Project description.
- `display_name` (String) Project display name.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Desired project power state.
- `limit_name` (Number) Optional limit selector used only during project creation.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_in` (String)
- `has_abuse` (Boolean)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `stopping_reason` (String)
